text: The robot handled 34 out of 108 orders successfully within an average time of 100 seconds per order, with a median of 94 seconds, showing steady performance despite some challenges. The top failure reason was "unknown" (39 times), affecting several orders including #2 and #67 [cite:2]. Orders that took longer than usual often had issues related to the unknown category, suggesting they might have encountered unexpected obstacles or objects during their pick-up process. To address this, ROBI could be programmed to perform a more thorough [[scene-scan]] before each order, increasing its understanding of the environment and reducing the likelihood of encountering unanticipated items.
